author: Steven T. Zalesak
title: Fully multidimensional flux-corrected transport algorithms for fluids
role: historical slotted-cylinder/FCT source; not the implemented method
review_scope: publisher bibliography and abstract inspected; direct full-paper open returned403; original test geometry and boundary conditions not audited

review.ja: 出版社の書誌と多次元FCTの抄録を確認。原著全文とその格子・境界・具体形状は今回未確認です。本例をZalesakのFCTアルゴリズム再現とは表示しません。
review.en: Publisher record and abstract checked. The full original test geometry/grid/boundaries were not audited. This example does not implement or reproduce Zalesak FCT.

author: Firedrake developers
title: DG advection equation with upwinding
role: actually inspected normalized slotted-disk geometry, rotation velocity and period
review_scope: official documentation equations and source lines46,63–92: disk(.5,.75),R.15,slot(.475,.525),y<.85,velocity(.5−y,x−.5),T2pi; SSP equations43–45 and135–143

review.ja: 公式デモの形状・回転速度・周期とSSPRK式を確認。元デモはbell・coneと背景1を加え、DQ1・流入値1を使います。本例はスロット円板だけの0–1指示関数・有限体積・周期境界という明示的な変形です。Firedrakeは実行・転載しません。
review.en: Inspected official geometry, velocity, period and SSP formulas. The demo includes a bell, cone, background1, DQ1 elements and inflow1. This is an explicit isolated0–1 slotted-disk FV/periodic variant. No Firedrake software was executed or copied.

author: Randall J. LeVeque
title: High-Resolution Conservative Algorithms for Advection in Incompressible Flow
role: conservative scalar-advection and donor-cell/minmod background; official demo attribution
review_scope: author-hosted paper selected sections1–3 actually inspected: PDE/incompressibility, FV means, minmod definition, donor-cell flux; no full-paper or numerical-table reproduction

review.ja: 著者公開論文の節1–3で保存形・非圧縮条件・セル平均・minmod・donor-cellを確認。Firedrakeが標準複合図形の出典として引用しています。本例のMUSCL＋SSPRKは同論文のCTU／波動伝播法そのものではありません。
review.en: Read sections1–3 on conservative transport, incompressibility, means, minmod and donor-cell fluxes. Firedrake cites this paper for its composite-shape test. Our MUSCL/SSPRK update is not the paper’s CTU/wave-propagation algorithm.

author: Chi-Wang Shu and Stanley Osher
title: Efficient implementation of essentially non-oscillatory shock-capturing schemes
review_scope: publisher bibliography/abstract inspected; actual three-stage convex formulas checked in official Firedrake demo, not a full original-paper audit

review.ja: 出版社の書誌とTVD Runge–Kuttaの抄録を確認。使う三段凸結合はFiredrake公式記述でも確認しました。原著全文の監査とは区別します。
review.en: Publisher bibliography/abstract checked; the actual three-stage convex formulas were also inspected in the official Firedrake demo. The original full paper was not audited.

author: SciPy developers
title: scipy.integrate.quad — SciPy v1.14.1 Manual
role: actually executed independent adaptive vertical-section quadrature for geometry qualification
review_scope: official versioned API: QUADPACK integration, break points, epsabs/epsrel, reported error; use is evidenced by qualification receipts

review.ja: 版を固定した公式APIでQUADPACK、分割点、絶対・相対公差と推定誤差の意味を確認。解析的な円・多角形の面積計算とは異なる垂直断面求積を、実行記録付きで照合します。
review.en: Versioned official API checked for QUADPACK, break points, tolerances and reported error. Independently integrated vertical sections are compared with circle/polygon areas; execution is established by saved receipts.
